### Page note: https://www.unepfi.org/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/Findex-Data-Book-2021.pdf
Reader state: complete; relevance: partial
**Page:** Untitled PDF (Global Findex Data Book 2021, pages 1‑30) – https://www.unepfi.org/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/Findex-Data-Book-2021.pdf  

**Evidence**  
| Entity | Measurement | Value | Year | Unit | Source Quote |
|--------|-------------|-------|------|------|--------------|
| Southeast Asia region list | Countries in the region | Cambodia; China; Indonesia; Lao People’s Democratic Republic; Malaysia; Mongolia; Myanmar; Philippines; Thailand; Vietnam | N/A | N/A | “East Asia and Pacific Cambodia; China; Indonesia; Lao People’s Democratic Republic;*\\nMalaysia; Mongolia; Myanmar;† Phillipines; Thailand; Vietnam‡” (Page 12) |
| East Asia & Pacific (regional aggregate) | Population, age 15+ | 1,679.1 million | 2021 | millions | “Population, age 15+ (millions) 1 ,679.1” (Page 14) |
| East Asia & Pacific (regional aggregate) | GNI per capita | 8,347.2 | 2021 | US$ | “GNI per capita ($) 8 , 347.2” (Page 14) |
| East Asia & Pacific (regional aggregate) | Account (% age 15+) – All adults | 80.8 % | 2021 | % | “Account (% age 15+) All adults, 2021 80.8” (Page 14) |
| East Asia & Pacific (regional aggregate) | Mobile money account (% age 15+) – All adults | 5.8 % | 2021 | % | “Mobile money account (% age 15+) All adults, 2021 5.8” (Page 14) |
| East Asia & Pacific (regional aggregate) | Made or received digital payments (% age 15+) – All adults | 76.1 % | 2021 | % | “Made or received digital payments in the past year (% age 15+) All adults, 2021 76.1” (Page 14) |
| World | Population, age 15+ | 5,762 million | 2021 | millions | “Population, age 15+ (millions) 5 ,762” (Page 13) |
| World | GNI per capita | 11,099.2 US$ | 2021 | US$ | “GNI per capita ($) 11 ,099.2” (Page 13) |
| World | Account (% age 15+) – All adults | 76.2 % | 2021 | % | “Account (% age 15+) All adults, 2021 76.2” (Page 13) |
| World | Mobile money account (% age 15+) – All adults | 10.2 % | 2021 | % | “Mobile money account (% age 15+) All adults, 2021 10.2” (Page 13) |
| World | Made or received digital payments (% age 15+) – All adults | 64.1 % | 2021 | % | “Made or received digital payments in the past year (% age 15+) All adults, 2021 64.1” (Page 13) |

**Coverage**  
- The supplied pages cover data for the **East Asia & Pacific region** as a whole (not individual countries).  
- It includes **population**, **GNI per capita**, **account ownership**, **mobile‑money account ownership**, and **digital payment activity** for 2021.  
- It lists the **Southeast Asian countries** that comprise this region but does **not** provide country‑specific values.  
- The pages do **not** contain any information on “mobile phone or internet to pay bills” or on GDP (gross domestic product).  

**Missing**  
1. Country‑specific GDP (or GNI) values for 2021 for each Southeast Asian country.  
2. Country‑specific percentages of respondents who used a mobile phone or the internet to pay bills (the variable is unspecified in the supplied pages).  
3. Any data on “mobile phone or internet usage” for bill payment.  

**Next links**  
| Missing Field | Suggested Source URL | Reason |
|---------------|----------------------|--------|
| Country‑specific GDP 2021 | https://data.worldbank.org/indicator/NY.GDP.MKTP.CD?locations=SG,MY,ID,TH,VN,KH,LA,MM,PH, CN | The World Bank’s World Development Indicators provide GDP values for each country. |
| % of respondents using mobile phone/internet to pay bills (2021) | https://globalfindex.worldbank.org | The Global Findex database includes the variable “mobile phone or internet to pay bills” for each country. |
